pl.gamedev/listing.note: Published to the official MCP Registry as pl.gamedev/creator 1.0.1 (1.0.0 was the first publish; versions are immutable). Live copy is served at /.well-known/mcp/server.json. Strip this pl.gamedev/listing block before running mcp-publisher — it is a repo-side marker, not registry content.
pl.gamedev/listing.auth: DNS domain proof on gamedev.pl (TXT v=MCPv1; k=ed25519), signed out-of-process by Google KMS: projects/gamedevpl/locations/global/keyRings/mcp/cryptoKeys/registry/cryptoKeyVersions/1. No private key file exists.
pl.gamedev/listing.metaCaveat: The official registry preserves only _meta["io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publisher-provided"] and silently drops all other keys, so pl.gamedev/auth above is NOT present in the registry entry. It is retained here because it is valid for the /.well-known/mcp/server.json copy, where the generic server.json spec permits custom reverse-DNS namespaces.
